checkpoints.check: Current location is clear in navigation
checkpoints.notes: Five start specimens: selected object, page and task are named. Static inspection only.

heuristics.name: Match between system and real world

checkpoints.check: Labels use user language, not internal jargon
checkpoints.notes: Expert judgment on sampled labels: Replace, Source, Preview and Send Round 3 to Lena name their tasks. User comprehension untested.

checkpoints.check: Information appears in natural and logical order
checkpoints.notes: F4 places blocking issue before tips; F5 shows round/status before send action.
All journeys is visible in sampled starts and has a native route to 302:3370. F4 close also has a route. Other exit behaviors untested.

checkpoints.check: UI elements behave the same way throughout
checkpoints.notes: Prototype-only issue C02: in F4.01, identical Fix links differ in operability: 303:32421 has a route, 303:32429 has none. Scope is limited to the tested prototype, not application behavior.

checkpoints.check: Terminology is consistent across all pages
checkpoints.notes: Sampled text uses the same rail, Preview, Publish, Content/Style/Behavior/Effects labels. No claim about all pages.
F1/F4/F5 screenshots share consistent rail, topbar, bottom navigation and right-task treatment; only these screenshots assessed.

checkpoints.check: Search and filter options are visible
checkpoints.notes: Search layers is visible in sampled starts. Filtering/search execution untested.

checkpoints.check: Visual hierarchy guides attention to important elements
checkpoints.notes: F4 visually prioritizes the blocker; F5 emphasizes Send Round 3 in task footer. This is a bounded visual judgment.
Three 1440px screenshots separate rail, tree, canvas and Inspector/task; other sizes not assessed.

heuristics.name: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors

checkpoints.check: Error messages are in plain language (no codes)
checkpoints.notes: F4.01 explains missing collection source in words without an error code.

checkpoints.check: Error messages indicate what went wrong specifically
checkpoints.notes: F4.01 names Latest posts and Home / Journal section.

checkpoints.check: Error messages suggest how to fix the issue
checkpoints.notes: Blocking Fix route goes to 303:32650, which names the exact list and Choose collection action. Route structure, not playback.

checkpoints.check: Errors are visually prominent and close to the source
checkpoints.notes: F4.01 displays blocker first with a selected-list canvas message; visual prominence assessed in screenshot.

checkpoints.check: Contextual help is provided where needed
checkpoints.notes: Prototype-only issue C01: F1.01 guidance 302:3510 says select a child, but the only product reaction is Add (302:3422). No child-selection route is present in this specimen. Generic controller guidance does not explain the constrained task.
Only five sampled opaque text/background pairs measured; see contrast.json. Other text, modes, hover and disabled states unknown.

checkpoints.check: Color is not the only way to convey information
checkpoints.notes: Sampled F4 error and F5 resolved states have text as well as color.
